items.example: The boy gave a shamefaced nod.
items.exampleCN: 男孩面带愧色地点了点头。

definition_zh: 在旁边；到一边；撇开；留着；（戏剧）旁白；题外话
definition_en: to or on one side, out of the way, kept for later use, a remark heard by the audience alone, or a short departure from the topic
core_image: 把挡在路中间的箱子挪到墙边，让出主路
scene: 搬运工把挡在门口的箱子挪到墙边，给推车让出一条通道。He stepped aside to let the cart pass.
sceneCN: 这里 aside 是「到一边、在旁边」（第 1 个义项：移到旁边位置，让出中间）；句意为「他往旁边让开，好让推车过去」。画面中有门口的箱子、墙边与推车。

pos.zh: 副词：在旁边；到一边；撇开；留着
名词：旁白；题外话

collocations.zh: 把某人拉到一边私下说

derivatives.zh: aside 的词根，义为「一边；侧面」，aside 即「在一边」
与 aside 同出 side，义为「在……旁边」

senses.title: To or on one side
senses.definition: to or toward one side, especially so as to clear the middle or make room
senses.definitionCN: 移向一侧，尤指为了空出中间或让出位置
senses.example: He stepped aside to let the cart pass.
senses.exampleCN: 他往旁边让开，好让推车过去。
senses.why: The word is a plus side: put something at the side, and the middle is left free.
senses.whyCN: 这个词就是「在一边」：把东西放到侧边，中间便空了出来。

senses.title: Out of the way, kept for later
senses.definition: out of use or out of the way for now, often reserved for a later purpose
senses.definitionCN: 暂时不用或放到不碍事的地方，常为日后用途保留
senses.example: She set aside part of her salary each month.
senses.exampleCN: 她每月把一部分工资存到一边。
senses.why: Money moved aside is exactly money taken out of the main flow and kept.
senses.whyCN: 被挪到一边的钱，正是从主流程里取出来、留存下来的钱。

senses.title: A stage remark for the audience
senses.definition: in a play, a short speech spoken so that other characters cannot hear it but the audience can
senses.definitionCN: 戏剧中角色所说、其他人物听不见而观众听得见的短句
senses.example: His aside revealed what he really thought of the duke.
senses.exampleCN: 他的旁白透露了他对公爵的真实看法。
senses.why: The speech is moved aside from the stage conversation, heard on a separate track.
senses.whyCN: 这句话被挪到舞台对话的旁边，像走在另一条声轨上。

senses.title: A short departure from the topic
senses.definition: a brief remark that departs from the main subject before returning to it
senses.definitionCN: 短暂偏离主题、随后又回到主题的一句话
senses.example: As an aside, the author mentions her own childhood.
senses.exampleCN: 作为题外话，作者提到了自己的童年。
senses.why: The remark takes one step to the side of the main road and then comes back.
senses.whyCN: 这句话往主路旁边走了一步，然后又走回来。

intro.en: Aside is simply 'on side': a worn-down phrase built from side, the native word for a flank.
intro.cn: aside 就是「在一边」：由表示侧面的本土词 side 磨损而成的一个短语。

items.en: 「*sīdaz」 is reconstructed as 'wide, long, extensive', the source of the word for a broad flank.
items.cn: 「*sīdaz」被重构为「宽的、长的、广阔的」，是表示宽大侧面的那个词的来源。

items.en: Sīd meant 'side, flank, breadth', the word for the edge of a thing rather than its middle.
items.cn: sīd 意为「侧面、侧边、宽度」，指的是物体的边缘而非中央。

items.en: The phrase on side and its shortened forms meant 'at the side', often beside a road or a wall.
items.cn: on side 及其缩短形式意为「在一边」，常指在道路或墙的旁边。

items.en: Aside is recorded as a single adverb meaning 'to one side, out of the way'.
items.cn: aside 作为单个副词被记录下来，意为「向一边、让开」。

items.en: The reserved-use sense appears in set aside, and the theatre sense names a speech spoken off to the side.
items.cn: 「留作后用」义出现在 set aside 里，戏剧义则指挪到一旁说的话。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words built on the same side root; the near-meaning group gathers words for position, distance and digression.
note.cn: 形近组收建立在同一「侧边」词根上的词；近义组收表示位置、离开与离题的词。

entries.definition: The edge or flank of something, as opposed to its middle.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「侧面、侧边」，与中央相对。

entries.definition: At the side of, or next to.
entries.definitionCN: 介词，义为「在……旁边」。

entries.definition: To accept or endure something, or to remain in a place.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「容忍、忍受」或「停留」。

entries.definition: Separated by distance or placed separately.
entries.definitionCN: 因距离而分开，或被单独放置。

entries.definition: At or to a distance from a place or person.
entries.definitionCN: 在或向离某地、某人有一段距离的地方。

entries.definition: A speech in a play in which a character alone speaks his or her thoughts.
entries.definitionCN: 戏剧中角色独自吐露心声的独白。

entries.definition: A temporary departure from the main subject in speech or writing.
entries.definitionCN: 说话或写作中暂时离开主题。

normalIntro.en: These hooks follow aside from a box moved to the wall to money saved, a stage whisper and a digression.
normalIntro.cn: 下面的钩子让 aside 从挪到墙边的箱子，走到存下的钱、舞台旁白与题外话。

normal.en: Aside is just 'on side': move it to the edge.
normal.cn: aside 就是「在一边」：把它挪到边缘。

normal.en: Step aside: the middle of the road opens.
normal.cn: 让到一边：路的中间就空出来了。

normal.en: Set aside money: keep it out of the main flow.
normal.cn: 把钱放到一边：让它离开主流程。

normal.en: A stage aside is spoken on a side track.
normal.cn: 舞台旁白走在另一条声轨上。

normal.en: As an aside: one step off the path, then back.
normal.cn: 作为题外话：往路边走一步，再走回来。

abstract.en: Everything aside is off to one side of something main.
abstract.cn: 所有 aside 都是主线的旁边。

abstract.en: Space, money, speech and topic all have sides.
abstract.cn: 空间、金钱、言语与话题都有「旁边」。

abstract.en: One small word covers both a physical step and a verbal one.
abstract.cn: 一个小词同时覆盖脚下的一步与嘴上的一步。

examples.en: He stepped aside to let the cart pass.
examples.cn: 他往旁边让开，好让推车过去。

examples.en: She set aside part of her salary each month.
examples.cn: 她每月把一部分工资存到一边。

examples.en: As an aside, the author mentions her own childhood.
examples.cn: 作为题外话，作者提到了自己的童年。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿赛德」——阿赛德把挡路的箱子挪到墙边，自己也让到一边：在旁边

root: aside 就是「在一边」：古英语 sīd 意为「侧面、侧边」，短语 on side 磨损成 aside，指移到旁边或留在旁边。由这个空间义出发，它指把东西搁到一边不再使用，也指为日后保留；戏剧里把台词挪到舞台对话的旁边，就是观众听得见、剧中人听不见的旁白；说话时往主题旁边走一步又走回来，就是题外话。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses all come from one side-step: moving aside, keeping aside, speaking aside on stage, and wandering aside from the topic.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项都来自同一次「往旁边挪」：让到一边、留到一边、在舞台上旁白，以及从话题边上游开。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a box blocking the doorway is moved to the wall, clearing the way.
core.cn: 核心意象：挡在门口的箱子被挪到墙边，路就空出来了。

branches.en: THE SPACE LINE: a physical move to one side.
branches.cn: 空间线：身体向旁边挪动。

branches.en: THE KEEPING LINE: something placed aside is reserved.
branches.cn: 留存线：放到一边的东西被留了下来。

branches.en: THE STAGE LINE: a speech moved off the main dialogue.
branches.cn: 舞台线：一句话被挪出主对话。

branches.en: THE TOPIC LINE: a remark walks beside the subject.
branches.cn: 话题线：一句话在主题旁边走。

branches.en: THE EVERYDAY LINE: money aside and words aside are both kept out of the main flow.
branches.cn: 日常线：存到一边的钱与挪到一边的话，都离开了主流程。

intro.en: Aside is a worn-down phrase rather than a suffixed word; its family is the set of verb phrases it forms.
intro.cn: aside 是磨损而成的短语而非加后缀的词，它的词族是由它构成的动词短语。

latinIntro.en: Aside is native English; its side root has no Latin counterpart here.
latinIntro.cn: aside 是本土英语词，它的 side 词根在这里没有对应的拉丁词。

items.meaning: to one side, out of the way
items.example: He drew the curtain aside.
items.exampleCN: 他把窗帘拉到一边。

items.example: The play is full of witty asides.
items.exampleCN: 这出戏里满是机智的旁白。

items.example: Aside from the rain, the trip was perfect.
items.exampleCN: 除了下雨，这次旅行很完美。

items.meaning: to reserve or put out of use
items.example: They set aside a day for repairs.
items.exampleCN: 他们留出一天来修理。

items.meaning: to place something out of the way
items.example: Put aside your doubts and start.
items.exampleCN: 把疑虑放到一边，开始吧。

items.meaning: to move out of the way, or to resign
items.example: The manager stepped aside for a younger rival.
items.exampleCN: 经理给一位更年轻的对手让了位。

items.example: She brushed aside the warning.
items.exampleCN: 她把那个警告随手拨开了。

items.meaning: to lead someone away for a private word
items.meaningCN: 把某人拉到一边私下说话
items.example: The coach took the player aside.
items.exampleCN: 教练把那名球员拉到一边。

definition_zh: 询问；请求；要求；邀请；索价；问候
definition_en: to put a question to someone, to request something, to invite someone, to name a price, or to inquire about a person's health
core_image: 一个人探身向前，把问题递到对方面前
scene: 前台的工作人员正低头翻找登记簿，客人扶着柜台探身过来。She asked the clerk whether the room was still available.
sceneCN: 这里 ask 是「询问」（第 1 个义项：向别人提出问题）；句意为「她问前台职员那间房是否还有空」。画面中有前台、登记簿与探身过来的客人。

pos.zh: 动词：询问；请求；要求；邀请；索价；问候

derivatives.zh: 由 ask 加 -ing 构成，义为「询问；请求」这一行为
由前缀 un- 加 asked 构成，义为「未被要求的；不请自来的」

senses.title: To put a question
senses.definition: to put a question to someone in order to get information
senses.definitionCN: 为了获得信息而向某人提出问题
senses.example: She asked the clerk whether the room was still available.
senses.exampleCN: 她问前台职员那间房是否还有空。
senses.why: The Old English verb meant to seek out an answer, so asking is reaching toward what you do not yet know.
senses.whyCN: 那个古英语动词意为「去寻求答案」，所以 ask 就是朝你还不知道的东西伸手。

senses.title: To request something
senses.definition: to request something from someone, or to seek permission to do something
senses.definitionCN: 向某人请求某物，或请求允许做某事
senses.example: He asked for a few more minutes to finish.
senses.exampleCN: 他请求再多给几分钟把事情做完。
senses.why: A request is a question about what someone will give, so the asking verb widens from words to things.
senses.whyCN: 请求就是在问对方愿不愿意给，于是这个「问」的动词从言语扩展到实物。

senses.title: To invite someone
senses.definition: to invite someone to an event or to go somewhere with you
senses.definitionCN: 邀请某人参加活动，或邀请对方同行
senses.example: They asked us to dinner on Saturday.
senses.exampleCN: 他们邀请我们周六去吃晚饭。
senses.why: An invitation asks whether the other person will come, so the same verb carries the question.
senses.whyCN: 邀请就是在问对方来不来，所以同一个动词自然也承担了这层询问。

senses.title: To name a price
senses.definition: to state the price one wants for something being sold
senses.definitionCN: 为出售之物报出自己想要的价格
senses.example: They are asking too much for that old car.
senses.exampleCN: 那辆旧车他们要价太高了。
senses.why: A seller's price is a request put as a question: will you pay this much?
senses.whyCN: 卖家的报价是以问句形式提出的请求：你肯付这个数吗？

senses.title: To inquire about someone's health
senses.definition: in ask after, to ask how someone is, especially someone absent
senses.definitionCN: 用于 ask after，询问某人的近况，尤指不在场的人
senses.example: She asked after your mother at the market.
senses.exampleCN: 她在市场上问起了你母亲的近况。
senses.why: Here the question is turned toward a person's condition, and the asking becomes a form of care.
senses.whyCN: 这里的问转向某个人的状况，询问就成了一种关心。

intro.en: Ask is a native English verb from the Germanic stock, with no Latin layer behind it.
intro.cn: ask 是来自日耳曼语族的本土英语动词，背后没有拉丁层。

items.en: 「*aiskōn」 meant 'to ask, seek out', and it is the form behind the English verb.
items.cn: 「*aiskōn」意为「询问、寻求」，英语动词的源头就是这一形式。

items.en: Āscian meant 'to ask, inquire, demand', and it was already used for requests as well as questions.
items.cn: āscian 意为「问、打听、要求」，当时就已同时用于提问与请求。

items.en: The verb shortened to asken and then ask, and the past forms asked took over.
items.cn: 动词缩短为 asken，再变成 ask，过去式 asked 逐渐固定下来。

items.en: The invitation sense is recorded early, while the price sense develops in trade contexts.
items.cn: 邀请义记录得较早，而索价义是在交易场合里发展出来的。

items.en: Ask after shows the verb's gentlest use: a question turned into concern for another person.
items.cn: ask after 展示了这个动词最温和的用法：把询问变成对他人的关心。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers short words close to ask in sound; the near-meaning group gathers verbs of questioning, requesting and inviting.
note.cn: 形近组收读音与 ask 接近的短词；近义组收表示询问、请求与邀请的动词。

entries.definition: A covering worn over the face, or something that hides a truth.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「面具、口罩」，或掩盖真相之物。

entries.definition: A piece of work that must be done.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「任务、工作」。

entries.definition: To lie in warmth or enjoy favour and attention.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「晒太阳」或「享受宠爱与关注」。

entries.definition: To ask for information, especially in a formal way.
entries.definitionCN: 尤指正式地询问信息。

entries.definition: To ask for something politely or formally.
entries.definitionCN: 礼貌或正式地请求某物。

entries.definition: To ask someone a series of questions, especially in an official setting.
entries.definitionCN: 尤指在正式场合向某人提出一连串问题。

entries.definition: To ask someone to come to an event or place.
entries.definitionCN: 邀请某人来参加活动或来到某处。

normalIntro.en: These hooks follow ask from a question at a desk to a request, an invitation, a price and a kind inquiry.
normalIntro.cn: 下面的钩子让 ask 从柜台前的一个问题，走到请求、邀请、报价与一句关心。

normal.en: Ask: lean forward and hand over a question.
normal.cn: ask：探身向前，把一个问句递过去。

normal.en: Ask for more time: the question becomes a request.
normal.cn: 请求多给些时间：问句变成了请求。

normal.en: Ask someone to dinner: the question is an invitation.
normal.cn: 请人吃饭：这个问句就是邀请。

normal.en: Ask a price: the seller's question is will you pay.
normal.cn: 报价：卖家问的是你肯不肯付。

normal.en: Ask after a friend: the question turns into care.
normal.cn: 问候朋友：询问变成了关心。

abstract.en: One verb covers questions, requests, invitations and prices.
abstract.cn: 一个动词覆盖提问、请求、邀请与报价。

abstract.en: All of them are ways of seeking an answer.
abstract.cn: 它们都是寻求一个答案的方式。

abstract.en: The gentlest use is asking after someone.
abstract.cn: 最温和的用法是问候某人的近况。

examples.en: She asked the clerk whether the room was still available.
examples.cn: 她问前台职员那间房是否还有空。

examples.en: He asked for a few more minutes to finish.
examples.cn: 他请求再多给几分钟把事情做完。

examples.en: They asked us to dinner on Saturday.
examples.cn: 他们邀请我们周六去吃晚饭。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿斯克」——阿斯克扶着柜台探身向前，把一个问句递了过去：询问

root: ask 是本土英语动词，来自原始西日耳曼语 *aiskōn「询问、寻求」，古英语作 āscian，意为「问、打听、要求」。它从一开始就同时承担提问与请求，于是长出一族用法：问信息是询问，问对方肯不肯给是请求，问对方来不来是邀请，问买家肯不肯付是索价，问某人的身体状况则是问候。

sensesIntro.en: Five senses all seek an answer: information, a favour, a presence, a price, or someone's health.
sensesIntro.cn: 五个义项都在寻求一个答案：信息、人情、到场、价钱，或某人的身体状况。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a person leaning forward to hand a question across a counter.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个人探身向前，把问题递过柜台。

branches.en: THE INFORMATION LINE: the plainest use, asking to know.
branches.cn: 信息线：最朴素的用法，问个明白。

branches.en: THE FAVOUR LINE: the question becomes a request for something.
branches.cn: 人情线：问句变成对某样东西的请求。

branches.en: THE INVITATION LINE: the question asks whether you will come.
branches.cn: 邀请线：问句在问你愿不愿意来。

branches.en: THE PRICE LINE: the question asks whether you will pay.
branches.cn: 价格线：问句在问你肯不肯付钱。

branches.en: THE CARE LINE: a request and a greeting both come from noticing another person.
branches.cn: 关怀线：请求与问候都源于注意到了另一个人。

intro.en: Ask is a native verb; its family is small and built with -ing and the negative prefix un-.
intro.cn: ask 是本土动词，词族很小，由 -ing 与否定前缀 un- 构成。

latinIntro.en: Ask has no Latin root, so there is no Latin family to list.
latinIntro.cn: ask 没有拉丁词根，因此这里没有拉丁词族可列。

items.example: Ask me anything you like.
items.exampleCN: 你想问什么都可以问。

items.example: He asks a question every minute.
items.exampleCN: 他每分钟都要问一个问题。

items.meaning: the present participle, or the act of asking
items.meaningCN: 现在分词，或「询问」这一行为
items.example: Asking costs nothing.
items.exampleCN: 开口问问不花什么成本。

items.meaning: the past tense and past participle
items.example: She asked for a glass of water.
items.exampleCN: 她要了一杯水。

items.meaning: not requested, or without being asked
items.meaningCN: 未被要求的，或不请自来的
items.example: He gave unasked advice to everyone.
items.exampleCN: 他逢人就给不请自来的建议。

items.example: Ask for help when you need it.
items.exampleCN: 需要时就开口求助。

items.example: He asked after her father.
items.exampleCN: 他问起了她父亲的近况。

items.meaning: to ask several people for information
items.example: Ask around before you buy.
items.exampleCN: 买之前先到处问问。

definition_zh: 睡着的；熟睡的；（肢体）麻木的；不活跃的
definition_en: in a state of sleep, numb in a limb, or quiet and not active
core_image: 台灯还亮着，书从手中滑落，人已经歪在椅子上
scene: 台灯还亮着，书从手里滑到地板，椅子上的人一动不动。The child fell asleep before the story ended.
sceneCN: 这里 asleep 是「睡着的」（第 1 个义项：处于睡眠状态）；句意为「故事还没讲完，孩子就睡着了」。画面中有亮着的台灯、滑落的书与歪在椅子上的孩子。

pos.zh: 形容词（多作表语）：睡着的；（肢体）麻木的；不活跃的

collocations.zh: 开车时打瞌睡；玩忽职守

forms.label: 无屈折变化（表语形容词）

derivatives.zh: asleep 的词根名词，义为「睡眠」，也可作动词「睡觉」
由 sleep 加 -y 构成，义为「困倦的；想睡的」
由 sleep 加 -ing 构成，义为「睡着的；供睡眠用的」

senses.title: In a state of sleep
senses.definition: in a state of sleep, especially after falling asleep
senses.definitionCN: 处于睡眠状态，尤指已经入睡
senses.example: The child fell asleep before the story ended.
senses.exampleCN: 故事还没讲完，孩子就睡着了。
senses.why: The word is a plus sleep: it names the state someone has entered, not the act of entering it.
senses.whyCN: 这个词就是「在睡眠中」：它指的是人已经进入的状态，而不是进入的动作。

senses.title: Numb in a limb
senses.definition: having no feeling in a part of the body, as when a foot has gone numb
senses.definitionCN: 身体某一部分失去感觉，如脚坐麻了
senses.example: My left foot was asleep after the long bus ride.
senses.exampleCN: 长途汽车坐久了，我的左脚麻了。
senses.why: A numb limb has gone quiet like a sleeping body, so it is described with the same word.
senses.whyCN: 麻木的肢体像睡着了一样安静，于是也用同一个词来形容。

senses.title: Quiet and inactive
senses.definition: not active or busy, as in a town or an industry that seems to be resting
senses.definitionCN: 不活跃、不繁忙，如沉寂的城镇或行业
senses.example: The harbour town is asleep outside the summer months.
senses.exampleCN: 夏季之外，这座港口小镇一片沉寂。
senses.why: Places can rest too, and a quiet street is described as if it had closed its eyes.
senses.whyCN: 地方也会休息，一条安静的街道就像闭上了眼睛。

intro.en: Asleep is a phrase, not a root word: it means 'on sleep', built like other a- words such as aside.
intro.cn: asleep 不是词根词而是短语，意思是「在睡眠中」，构词方式与 aside 这类 a- 开头的词相同。

items.en: 「*slēpan」 meant 'to sleep', and it is the source of the English sleep family.
items.cn: 「*slēpan」意为「睡觉」，是英语 sleep 一族词的来源。

items.en: Slǣpan meant 'to sleep', and the noun slǣp named the state.
items.cn: slǣpan 意为「睡觉」，名词 slǣp 指睡眠这一状态。

items.en: The phrase on sleep, later asleep, described someone in the state of sleeping.
items.cn: 短语 on sleep（后来的 asleep）用来描述处在睡眠状态中的人。

items.en: Asleep is recorded as a single adjective, and it stayed in predicative use after verbs such as fall and be.
items.cn: asleep 作为单一形容词被记录下来，并一直跟在 fall、be 这类动词后作表语。

items.en: The numb-limb and quiet-town senses extend the image of a body or place at rest.
items.cn: 肢体麻木与城镇沉寂两义，把「身体或地方在休息」这一形象推广开来。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words close to asleep in sound or spelling; the near-meaning group gathers words for sleeping, numb and inactive.
note.cn: 形近组收读音或拼写与 asleep 接近的词；近义组收表示睡着、麻木与不活跃的词。

entries.definition: The natural state of rest, or to be in that state.
entries.definitionCN: 名词或动词，义为「睡眠」或「睡觉」。

entries.definition: A surface that rises or falls at an angle.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「斜坡、斜面」。

entries.definition: Smooth and glossy, often stylishly so.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「光滑的、油亮的」，常带时髦意味。

entries.definition: In the state of sleep, often used before a noun.
entries.definitionCN: 处于睡眠中的，常放在名词前。

entries.definition: Not active for a time, as a volcano or a business.
entries.definitionCN: 暂时不活动的，如休眠的火山或停滞的企业。

entries.definition: Unable to feel anything in a part of the body.
entries.definitionCN: 身体某部分失去感觉的。

entries.definition: Not awake and not aware, as after an injury.
entries.definitionCN: 没有醒来、失去知觉的，如受伤之后。

normalIntro.en: These hooks move from a lamp left on to a numb foot and a silent harbour town.
normalIntro.cn: 下面的钩子从没关的台灯，走到发麻的脚与寂静的港口小镇。

normal.en: Asleep is 'on sleep': the person is inside the state.
normal.cn: asleep 就是「在睡眠中」：人待在这个状态里。

normal.en: The book slips down and the child is already asleep.
normal.cn: 书滑落了，孩子已经睡着了。

normal.en: A numb foot is asleep too.
normal.cn: 发麻的脚也算 asleep。

normal.en: A quiet harbour town is asleep after summer.
normal.cn: 夏季之后，安静的港口小镇也「睡着了」。

normal.en: The word always follows a verb such as fall or be.
normal.cn: 这个词总跟在 fall 或 be 这类动词后面。

abstract.en: Sleep is the state; asleep is the position inside it.
abstract.cn: sleep 是那个状态，asleep 是处在状态里的位置。

abstract.en: A body, a limb and a town can all rest.
abstract.cn: 身体、肢体与城镇都能休息。

abstract.en: The quietness is shared by all three senses.
abstract.cn: 三种义项共享同一种安静。

examples.en: The child fell asleep before the story ended.
examples.cn: 故事还没讲完，孩子就睡着了。

examples.en: My left foot was asleep after the long bus ride.
examples.cn: 长途汽车坐久了，我的左脚麻了。

examples.en: The harbour town is asleep outside the summer months.
examples.cn: 夏季之外，这座港口小镇一片沉寂。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿睡普」——阿睡普趴在桌上，书滑到地上还没醒：睡着的

root: asleep 不是词根词，而是「在睡眠中」这一短语固化成形容词：a- 表示「在……状态」，sleep 表示睡眠。古英语 slǣpan 意为「睡觉」，短语 on sleep 后来写成 asleep。它主要指人已进入睡眠状态，也因此形容失去感觉的肢体（像睡着一样安静），以及不再活跃的城镇或行业。它多作表语，跟在 fall、be 这类动词后面。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses all describe something at rest: a sleeping person, a limb without feeling, and a place that has gone quiet.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项都在描述处于休息状态的东西：睡着的人、失去感觉的肢体，以及安静下来的地方。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a lamp still burning, a book slipping to the floor, a body slumped in a chair.
core.cn: 核心意象：台灯还亮着，书滑到地板，一个人歪在椅子上。

branches.en: THE SLEEPER LINE: a person has entered the state of sleep.
branches.cn: 睡眠线：人已经进入了睡眠状态。

branches.en: THE LIMB LINE: a foot loses feeling and goes quiet.
branches.cn: 肢体线：脚失去感觉，安静下来。

branches.en: THE TOWN LINE: a place stops being busy.
branches.cn: 城镇线：一个地方不再繁忙。

branches.en: THE REST LINE: a sleeping body and a numb limb share the same stillness.
branches.cn: 休息线：睡着的身体与麻木的肢体共享同一种静止。

branches.en: THE QUIET LINE: people and places both close their eyes.
branches.cn: 安静线：人与地方都会闭上眼睛。

intro.en: Asleep is a fixed phrase rather than a suffixed word; its family comes from the noun and verb sleep.
intro.cn: asleep 是固化短语而非加后缀的词，它的词族来自名词与动词 sleep。

latinIntro.en: Sleep is a native Germanic word, so there is no Latin counterpart here.
latinIntro.cn: sleep 是本土日耳曼词，这里没有对应的拉丁词。

items.example: The baby is asleep in the next room.
items.exampleCN: 婴儿在隔壁房间睡着了。

items.example: She sleeps eight hours a night.
items.exampleCN: 她每晚睡八小时。

items.meaning: the present participle or an adjective
items.example: A sleeping cat lay on the step.
items.exampleCN: 一只睡着的猫躺在台阶上。

items.example: The warm room made us sleepy.
items.exampleCN: 温暖的房间让我们犯困。

items.meaning: the past tense and past participle
items.example: He slept through the alarm.
items.exampleCN: 他睡过了闹钟。

items.meaning: a person who sleeps, or a sleeping car
items.example: The sleeper train leaves at midnight.
items.exampleCN: 卧铺列车午夜出发。

items.example: She spent a sleepless night before the exam.
items.exampleCN: 考试前她一夜没睡。

items.example: Do not oversleep on the first day.
items.exampleCN: 第一天可别睡过头。

definition_zh: 方面；层面；外观；样子；（语法）体；朝向
definition_en: one side of a matter, the appearance of something, a grammatical category of verbs, or the position of a planet
core_image: 同一座房子，从不同角度看到不同的面
scene: 同一座老宅，站在街上看到的是斑驳的墙面，绕到后院却是新修的花园。We must consider every aspect of the plan before we vote.
sceneCN: 这里 aspect 是「方面、层面」（第 1 个义项：一件事的某一个侧面）；句意为「投票前我们必须考虑这个计划的每个方面」。画面中有老宅的正面、后院与新修的花园。

pos.zh: 名词：方面；层面；外观；样子；（语法）体；朝向

derivatives.zh: 由 aspect 加 -ual 构成，义为「（语法）体的」
由 aspectual 加 -ity 构成，义为「体性」，语言学术语

senses.title: One side of a matter
senses.definition: one particular part or side of a situation, problem, or subject
senses.definitionCN: 情况、问题或主题中某一个特定的部分或侧面
senses.example: We must consider every aspect of the plan before we vote.
senses.exampleCN: 投票前我们必须考虑这个计划的每个方面。
senses.why: Latin aspectus meant a look or a view, and a matter seen from one angle shows one of its faces.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 aspectus 意为「看、视角」，一件事从某个角度看，就露出它的一个面。

senses.title: The look of something
senses.definition: the appearance of a person, place, or thing, especially as it seems at a particular time
senses.definitionCN: 人、地方或事物的外貌，尤指某一时刻给人的印象
senses.example: The garden took on a gloomy aspect under the grey sky.
senses.exampleCN: 灰蒙蒙的天空下，花园显出一副阴沉的样子。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense: aspect is simply what a thing looks like when you face it.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的义项：aspect 就是当你面对某物时它看上去的样子。

senses.title: A grammatical category
senses.definition: a verb category showing how an action unfolds in time, such as simple, progressive, or perfect
senses.definitionCN: 动词范畴，表示动作在时间中如何展开，如一般、进行、完成
senses.example: English marks aspect with forms such as is running.
senses.exampleCN: 英语用 is running 这类形式来标记「体」。
senses.why: Grammarians borrowed the word for a view: an action is seen from a particular angle in time.
senses.whyCN: 语法学家借用了「视角」这个词：动作在时间中被从某个角度观看。

senses.title: A position of the stars
senses.definition: the position of a planet or the stars in relation to one another, especially in astrology
senses.definitionCN: 行星或星辰彼此之间的相对位置，尤用于占星
senses.example: The astrologer studied the aspect of Mars and Venus.
senses.exampleCN: 占星师研究了火星与金星的方位关系。
senses.why: Planets face each other at certain angles, and each angle is a way of looking across the sky.
senses.whyCN: 行星以特定角度彼此相望，每个角度都是一种横看天空的方式。

intro.en: Aspect comes from a Latin verb meaning to look at, and every sense is a way of looking at something.
intro.cn: aspect 来自一个意为「观看」的拉丁动词，每个义项都是一种看事物的方式。

items.en: The root 「*speḱ-」 meant 'to see, look', and it stands behind many seeing words in Latin and Greek.
items.cn: 词根「*speḱ-」意为「看、观看」，拉丁语与希腊语中许多表示「看」的词都由它而来。

items.en: Aspicere, from ad- 'to' plus specere 'to look', meant 'to look at, observe'.
items.cn: aspicere 由 ad-「向」加 specere「看」构成，意为「注视、观察」。

items.en: Aspectus meant 'a look, a view, appearance', and could also name the position of a heavenly body.
items.cn: aspectus 意为「一瞥、视角、外观」，也能指天体的方位。

items.en: Old French aspect kept both the appearance sense and the astronomical one.
items.cn: 古法语 aspect 同时保留「外观」义与天象义。

items.en: English used aspect for appearance and for the stars, and the 'side of a matter' sense came later.
items.cn: 英语最早用 aspect 指外观与星辰，后来才发展出「事情的方面」这一义。

items.en: Grammar added the verb sense in the nineteenth century, viewing an action from an angle in time.
items.cn: 语法学在十九世纪添上动词「体」义，从时间中的某个角度观看动作。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words sharing the Latin seeing root; the near-meaning group gathers sides, facets and appearances.
note.cn: 形近组收共享拉丁「看」词根的词；近义组收表示侧面、层面与外观的词。

entries.definition: To look at something closely to check its condition.
entries.definitionCN: 仔细查看某物以检查其状况。

entries.definition: A striking public display or sight.
entries.definitionCN: 引人注目的公开场面或景象。

entries.definition: Admiration for someone, or a particular point or detail.
entries.definitionCN: 对他人的敬意，或某个具体的方面、细节。

entries.definition: One part or face of a matter.
entries.definitionCN: 事情的一个部分或一个面。

entries.definition: One of the many sides of a subject.
entries.definitionCN: 一个主题众多侧面中的一个。

entries.definition: A particular way of viewing a situation.
entries.definitionCN: 看待某一情况的特定角度。

entries.definition: The way something looks to the eye.
entries.definitionCN: 某物呈现在眼中的样子。

normalIntro.en: These hooks move from one house seen from two sides to a gloomy garden, a verb form and the stars.
normalIntro.cn: 下面的钩子从一座房子从两边看，走到阴沉的花园、动词形式与星辰。

normal.en: One house, many faces: each angle is an aspect.
normal.cn: 一座房子有许多面：每个角度都是一个 aspect。

normal.en: The same problem seen from the side shows another aspect.
normal.cn: 同一个问题从侧面看，会露出另一个方面。

normal.en: The garden's aspect under grey sky is gloomy.
normal.cn: 灰天下花园的 aspect 是阴沉的。

normal.en: Grammar views an action from an angle in time.
normal.cn: 语法从时间中的某个角度观看动作。

normal.en: Planets face each other at an aspect.
normal.cn: 行星以某个方位彼此相望。

abstract.en: Every sense is a way of looking at something.
abstract.cn: 每一个义项都是看某样东西的一种方式。

abstract.en: A face, a side and a view share one root.
abstract.cn: 面容、侧面与视角共用一个词根。

abstract.en: The word moves easily from space to grammar to the sky.
abstract.cn: 这个词从空间滑到语法，再滑到天空。

examples.en: We must consider every aspect of the plan before we vote.
examples.cn: 投票前我们必须考虑这个计划的每个方面。

examples.en: The garden took on a gloomy aspect under the grey sky.
examples.cn: 灰蒙蒙的天空下，花园显出一副阴沉的样子。

examples.en: The astrologer studied the aspect of Mars and Venus.
examples.cn: 占星师研究了火星与金星的方位关系。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿斯佩克特」——阿斯佩克特绕到房子背面，看到另一个面：方面

root: aspect 来自拉丁语 aspicere「注视」，由 ad-「向」加 specere「看」构成；其名词 aspectus 意为「一瞥、视角、外观」，也能指天体方位。因此它先指「样子、外观」，后指「从某一角度看到的一面」，即事情的方面；语法学又借它表示「体」——从时间中的某个角度观看动作；占星术里的 aspect 则是行星彼此的方位。词根 specere 还留在 inspect、spectacle 里。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses are four ways of looking: at one side of a matter, at a thing's appearance, at how a verb unfolds, and at the stars' angle.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项是四种看的方式：看事情的一个侧面、看一个事物的样子、看动词如何展开，以及看星辰的方位。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one old house showing a weathered wall from the street and a new garden from the back.
core.cn: 核心意象：同一座老宅，从街上看到斑驳的墙，从后院看到新修的花园。

branches.en: THE MATTER LINE: a complex thing is considered one side at a time.
branches.cn: 事情线：复杂的事物被一个面一个面地看。

branches.en: THE FACE LINE: the oldest sense, simply how a thing looks.
branches.cn: 面容线：最古老的义项，就是某物看上去的样子。

branches.en: THE GRAMMAR LINE: an action is viewed from an angle in time.
branches.cn: 语法线：动作被从时间中的某个角度观看。

branches.en: THE SKY LINE: planets face each other at fixed angles.
branches.cn: 天空线：行星以固定角度彼此相望。

branches.en: THE EVERYDAY LINE: the side of a problem and the look of a place are both aspects.
branches.cn: 日常线：问题的侧面与地方的样子，都是 aspect。

intro.en: Aspect is a Latin noun; its family adds -ual and -ity, and the root specere also builds inspect and spectacle.
intro.cn: aspect 是拉丁名词，词族加 -ual 与 -ity；词根 specere 还构成 inspect 与 spectacle。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root specere 'to look' also gave English inspect, spectacle and perspective.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根 specere「看」还给英语留下了 inspect、spectacle 与 perspective。

items.meaning: a look, a view, one side of a thing
items.meaningCN: 一看、视角、事物的一个侧面
items.example: The financial aspect worries them most.
items.exampleCN: 财务方面最让他们担心。

items.example: The report covers all aspects of the case.
items.exampleCN: 报告涵盖了这个案子的各个方面。

items.example: The paper studies aspectual meaning.
items.exampleCN: 这篇论文研究「体」的意义。

items.example: Aspectuality varies across languages.
items.exampleCN: 「体性」在各语言中不尽相同。

items.example: Officials inspected the bridge.
items.exampleCN: 官员们检查了这座桥。

items.meaningCN: 引人注目的景象或场面
items.example: The fireworks were a fine spectacle.
items.exampleCN: 那场烟火十分壮观。

items.meaning: a point of view, or the art of showing depth
items.meaningCN: 视角，或表现纵深的透视法
items.example: Try seeing it from her perspective.
items.exampleCN: 试着从她的角度看这件事。

items.meaning: the proportion of width to height
items.example: The film uses a wide aspect ratio.
items.exampleCN: 这部影片采用宽幅比例。

latinEntries.example: The parade was quite a spectacle.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 这场游行相当壮观。

latinEntries.example: They inspect the goods on arrival.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 货物到达时他们会检查。

definition_zh: 评估；评定；估算；核定（税额）
definition_en: to judge or estimate the value, quality, or amount of something, to rate a person's work, or to fix a tax
core_image: 一只手把砝码放上天平，看两边是否平衡
scene: 查勘员蹲在开裂的墙边，用卷尺量着裂缝的长度。The engineer assessed the damage after the flood.
sceneCN: 这里 assess 是「评估、估算」（第 1 个义项：判断损失、价值或风险的大小）；句意为「洪水过后，工程师评估了损失」。画面中有开裂的墙、卷尺与蹲在墙边的查勘员。

pos.zh: 动词：评估；评定；估算；核定（税额）

derivatives.zh: 由 assess 加名词后缀 -ment 构成，义为「评估；评定；核定」
由 assess 加 -or 构成，义为「评估员；估税员」
由 assess 加 -able 构成，义为「可评估的；可征税的」
由前缀 re- 加 assess 构成，义为「重新评估」

senses.title: To judge the value or size
senses.definition: to judge or estimate the value, size, risk, or seriousness of something
senses.definitionCN: 判断或估算某物的价值、规模、风险或严重程度
senses.example: The engineer assessed the damage after the flood.
senses.exampleCN: 洪水过后，工程师评估了损失。
senses.why: The Latin verb meant to sit beside, and an assessor sat beside a judge to weigh a case.
senses.whyCN: 那个拉丁动词意为「坐在旁边」，估税员正是坐在法官旁边，为案子称一称分量。

senses.title: To rate a person's work
senses.definition: to judge the quality of a student's work or a person's ability, often formally
senses.definitionCN: 评定学生作业或某人能力的水平，常为正式评定
senses.example: Teachers assess each essay against the same standards.
senses.exampleCN: 老师们按同一套标准评定每篇作文。
senses.why: Weighing an object and weighing a pupil's work use the same gesture: set it against a standard.
senses.whyCN: 称一件物品与评一份作业用的是同一个动作：把它放到标准旁边。

senses.title: To fix a tax or charge
senses.definition: to calculate and fix the amount of tax, fine, or payment owed by someone
senses.definitionCN: 计算并确定某人应缴的税额、罚款或费用
senses.example: The council assessed the property at a higher rate.
senses.exampleCN: 市政会按更高的税率核定了这处房产的税额。
senses.why: This is the oldest recorded use: an official sits beside the property and fixes what it owes.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的用法：官员坐在产业旁边，定下它该缴多少。

intro.en: Assess begins with a Latin image of someone sitting beside another to weigh a matter.
intro.cn: assess 起初是一个拉丁意象：有人坐在另一个人旁边，为事情称一称分量。

items.en: The root 「*sed-」 meant 'to sit', and it lies behind many Latin words for sitting and settling.
items.cn: 词根「*sed-」意为「坐」，拉丁语中许多表示坐与安顿的词都由它而来。

items.en: Assidere meant 'to sit beside', from ad- 'to' plus sedere 'to sit'.
items.cn: assidere 意为「坐在旁边」，由 ad-「向」加 sedere「坐」构成。

items.en: An assessor was an official who sat beside a magistrate to fix taxes and fines.
items.cn: assessor 是坐在长官旁边、协助核定税额与罚金的官员。

items.en: Assesser took the verb form and kept the sense of fixing an amount owed.
items.cn: 古法语 assesser 取下动词形式，保留「核定应缴数额」的意思。

items.en: English assess began with taxes and fines, and only later widened to judging value in general.
items.cn: 英语里的 assess 先用于税额与罚金，后来才放宽到泛指评估价值。

items.en: Now pupils, risks, damage and property can all be assessed, with the same weighing gesture.
items.cn: 如今学生、风险、损失与房产都可以被 assess，用的是同一个称量的动作。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers verbs close to assess in spelling; the near-meaning group gathers verbs of judging and estimating.
note.cn: 形近组收拼写与 assess 接近的动词；近义组收表示判断与估算的动词。

entries.definition: To own or have something.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「拥有、具有」。

entries.definition: The right or chance to use or reach something.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「使用权、接近的机会」。

entries.definition: To help someone do something.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「帮助、协助」。

entries.definition: To judge the value or quality of something carefully.
entries.definitionCN: 仔细判断某物的价值或质量。

entries.definition: To calculate an approximate value or amount.
entries.definitionCN: 计算出一个大约的价值或数量。

entries.definition: To form an opinion about something after thought.
entries.definitionCN: 经过思考后对某事形成看法。

entries.definition: To give something a particular level of quality or value.
entries.definitionCN: 给某物定出某种质量或价值等级。

normalIntro.en: These hooks move from weights on a scale to a marked essay, a tax bill and a measured risk.
normalIntro.cn: 下面的钩子从天平上的砝码，走到批改的作文、税单与衡量的风险。

normal.en: Assess: put the object beside the standard and weigh it.
normal.cn: assess：把对象放到标准旁边，称一称。

normal.en: An assessor sits beside the judge.
normal.cn: 估税员坐在法官旁边。

normal.en: Assess an essay: the work is placed against a mark scheme.
normal.cn: 评定作文：把作业放到评分标准旁边。

normal.en: Assess a tax: the property is weighed for what it owes.
normal.cn: 核定税额：把产业称一称，看它该缴多少。

normal.en: Assess a risk: the danger is put on the same scale.
normal.cn: 评估风险：把危险也放到同一架天平上。

abstract.en: Everything assessed is weighed against something else.
abstract.cn: 凡被 assess 的东西，都是被放到另一样东西旁边称量。

abstract.en: Tax, teaching and risk all use the same gesture.
abstract.cn: 税务、教学与风险用的是同一个动作。

abstract.en: The word began at a judge's side and spread to every scale.
abstract.cn: 这个词从法官身旁开始，扩散到每一架天平。

examples.en: The engineer assessed the damage after the flood.
examples.cn: 洪水过后，工程师评估了损失。

examples.en: Teachers assess each essay against the same standards.
examples.cn: 老师们按同一套标准评定每篇作文。

examples.en: The council assessed the property at a higher rate.
examples.cn: 市政会按更高的税率核定了这处房产的税额。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿塞斯」——阿塞斯把砝码放上天平，估一估那堆东西的分量：评估

root: assess 来自拉丁语 assidere「坐在旁边」，由 ad-「向」加 sedere「坐」构成；assessor 原是坐在长官旁边、协助核定税额与罚金的官员。因此它先表示「核定应缴数额」，后来放宽为「评估价值、损失、风险」，再延伸到「评定学生的表现」。三个义项的共同动作都是把对象放到某个标准旁边，称一称它的分量。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses share one gesture, weighing against a standard: judging value or risk, rating a pupil's work, and fixing a tax.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项共享同一个动作，把对象放到标准旁边称量：判断价值或风险、评定学生作业，以及核定税额。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand setting a weight on a balance to see whether the two sides match.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手把砝码放上天平，看两边是否平衡。

branches.en: THE SCALE LINE: value, damage and risk are all weighed.
branches.cn: 天平线：价值、损失与风险都要过秤。

branches.en: THE SCHOOL LINE: a pupil's work is placed against a standard.
branches.cn: 学校线：学生的作业被放到标准旁边。

branches.en: THE TAX LINE: an official fixes what a property owes.
branches.cn: 税务线：官员定下产业该缴多少。

branches.en: THE OFFICIAL LINE: the first assessors sat beside magistrates.
branches.cn: 公务线：最早的估税员坐在长官旁边。

branches.en: THE STANDARD LINE: every assessment needs something to compare against.
branches.cn: 标准线：任何评估都需要一个可比照的东西。

intro.en: Assess is a Latin verb carried through French; its family adds -ment, -or, -able and the prefix re-.
intro.cn: assess 是经法语传来的拉丁动词，词族加 -ment、-or、-able 与前缀 re-。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root sedere 'to sit' also produced sedentary, session and sediment.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根 sedere「坐」还生出 sedentary、session 与 sediment。

items.meaning: to sit beside, then to fix a value
items.meaningCN: 坐在旁边，后指核定价值
items.example: They assess each case on its facts.
items.exampleCN: 他们按事实评估每个案子。

items.example: The board assesses every proposal.
items.exampleCN: 委员会评估每一份提案。

items.example: They are assessing the flood damage.
items.exampleCN: 他们正在评估洪灾损失。

items.meaning: the past tense and past participle
items.example: The house was assessed at a high value.
items.exampleCN: 这栋房子被估了高价。

items.meaning: the act or result of assessing
items.example: The assessment took three weeks.
items.exampleCN: 这次评估用了三周。

items.meaning: a person who assesses, especially for tax
items.example: The assessor valued the land.
items.exampleCN: 估税员估定了这块地的价值。

items.meaning: able to be assessed or taxed
items.example: Only part of the income is assessable.
items.exampleCN: 只有部分收入需要计税。

items.example: We must reassess the plan in spring.
items.exampleCN: 春天我们得重新评估这个计划。

latinEntries.example: A sedentary job weakens the back.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 久坐的工作会让背部变弱。

latinEntries.meaning: a period of sitting together for work
latinEntries.meaningCN: 坐在一起工作的一段时间
latinEntries.example: The morning session lasted two hours.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 上午的会议持续了两小时。

definition_zh: 评估；评定；评价；教育测评；核定（税额）；评估结果
definition_en: the act of judging the value, quality, or amount of something, a formal judgement, a test of learning, or a tax fixed by authority
core_image: 一叠批改过的作文与一支红笔，旁边写着定好的分数
scene: 学期末的办公桌上摊着一摞作文，红笔在每页的分数栏里落下数字。The assessment of each essay took about ten minutes.
sceneCN: 这里 assessment 是「评估、评定」（第 1 个义项：判断价值或质量的行为）；句意为「每篇作文的评定大约花了十分钟」。画面中有摊开的作文、红笔与分数栏。

pos.zh: 名词：评估；评定；评价；教育测评；核定税额；评估结果

derivatives.zh: assessment 的动词形式，义为「评估；评定；核定」
由 assess 加 -or 构成，义为「评估员；估税员」
由 assess 加 -able 构成，义为「可评估的；可征税的」
由前缀 re- 加 assessment 构成，义为「重新评估」

senses.title: The act of judging value or quality
senses.definition: the act of judging or estimating the value, quality, or seriousness of something
senses.definitionCN: 判断或估算某物的价值、质量或严重程度的行为
senses.example: The assessment of each essay took about ten minutes.
senses.exampleCN: 每篇作文的评定大约花了十分钟。
senses.why: -ment turns the verb assess into the action itself: the sitting-beside and weighing is now a named event.
senses.whyCN: 后缀 -ment 把动词 assess 变成动作本身：那场「坐在旁边称一称」如今成了一个有名字的事件。

senses.title: A test of learning
senses.definition: a formal test or judgement of a pupil's progress, often spread over a course
senses.definitionCN: 对学生学习进展的正式测评，常贯穿整个课程
senses.example: The course uses continuous assessment instead of one final exam.
senses.exampleCN: 这门课采用持续性评价，而不是一次期末考试。
senses.why: If weighing a pupil's work is assess, then the whole system of weighing is an assessment.
senses.whyCN: 如果评一份作业是 assess，那么整套称量的制度就是 assessment。

senses.title: A tax fixed by authority
senses.definition: an official calculation of the tax or fine owed by a person or property
senses.definitionCN: 对个人或财产应缴税款、罚金的官方计算
senses.example: The tax assessment arrived with the winter bill.
senses.exampleCN: 税额核定单随冬季账单一起寄到。
senses.why: This is the oldest official use: an assessor sits beside the property and names the sum.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的官方用法：估税员坐在产业旁边，报出一个数目。

senses.title: The judgement reached
senses.definition: the opinion or rating that results from assessing something
senses.definitionCN: 评估某物之后得出的意见或评级
senses.example: Her assessment was that the plan needed more time.
senses.exampleCN: 她的评价是这个计划还需要更多时间。
senses.why: By shifting from the act to its result, an assessment becomes the verdict someone has reached.
senses.whyCN: 由行为转指结果，assessment 便成了某人得出的结论。

intro.en: Assessment is the noun of assess, and both keep the Latin image of an official sitting beside a property to fix its value.
intro.cn: assessment 是 assess 的名词，两者都保留着「官员坐在产业旁边核定价值」这一拉丁意象。

items.en: The root 「*sed-」 meant 'to sit', and it lies behind many Latin words for sitting and settling.
items.cn: 词根「*sed-」意为「坐」，拉丁语中许多表示坐与安顿的词都由它而来。

items.en: Assidere meant 'to sit beside', from ad- 'to' plus sedere 'to sit'.
items.cn: assidere 意为「坐在旁边」，由 ad-「向」加 sedere「坐」构成。

items.en: An assessor sat beside a magistrate to fix taxes and fines.
items.cn: assessor 坐在长官旁边，协助核定税额与罚金。

items.en: Assesser carried the verb into French with the sense of fixing what is owed.
items.cn: 古法语 assesser 把这个动词带进法语，意思是核定应缴数额。

items.en: English assess began with taxes, and assessment followed as its noun.
items.cn: 英语的 assess 先用于税务，assessment 随后作为它的名词出现。

items.en: Education gave the word a large new field: continuous assessment now weighs pupils, not property.
items.cn: 教育为这个词开辟了大片新领域：持续性评价如今称量的是学生，而非产业。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers nouns close to assessment in form; the near-meaning group gathers evaluations, appraisals and reviews.
note.cn: 形近组收形式上与 assessment 接近的名词；近义组收评估、鉴定与复查。

entries.definition: A person who assesses, especially one who values property for tax.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「评估员、估税员」。

entries.definition: A part cut off from a whole.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「部分、片段」。

entries.definition: A confident statement that something is true.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「断言、主张」。

entries.definition: A careful judgement of value or quality.
entries.definitionCN: 对价值或质量的仔细判断。

entries.definition: A judgement of worth, often of property or performance.
entries.definitionCN: 对价值的评估，常指房产或表现。

entries.definition: An opinion or decision formed after thought.
entries.definitionCN: 经过思考后形成的意见或决定。

entries.definition: An examination of something to judge its state or quality.
entries.definitionCN: 为判断状况或质量而进行的检查。

normalIntro.en: These hooks move from marked essays to a school report, a tax notice and a spoken verdict.
normalIntro.cn: 下面的钩子从批改过的作文，走到成绩报告、税单与一句口头结论。

normal.en: Assessment is assess turned into a named event.
normal.cn: assessment 是把 assess 变成一个有名有姓的事件。

normal.en: An assessment of essays: each one is weighed.
normal.cn: 作文评估：每一篇都过一回秤。

normal.en: Continuous assessment: the weighing never stops.
normal.cn: 持续性评价：称量一直没停。

normal.en: A tax assessment: the property is weighed for what it owes.
normal.cn: 税额核定：产业被称一称，看它该缴多少。

normal.en: Her assessment was a verdict in one sentence.
normal.cn: 她的一句评价就是最终结论。

abstract.en: The noun names the act and then the verdict.
abstract.cn: 这个名词先指动作，再指结论。

abstract.en: Tax and school both use the same scale.
abstract.cn: 税务与学校用的是同一架天平。

abstract.en: Every assessment needs a standard to weigh against.
abstract.cn: 任何评估都需要一个可比照的标准。

examples.en: The assessment of each essay took about ten minutes.
examples.cn: 每篇作文的评定大约花了十分钟。

examples.en: The course uses continuous assessment instead of one final exam.
examples.cn: 这门课采用持续性评价，而不是一次期末考试。

examples.en: Her assessment was that the plan needed more time.
examples.cn: 她的评价是这个计划还需要更多时间。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿塞斯门」——阿塞斯门坐在办公桌前，把每份作业都称一称、打个分：评估

root: assessment 是 assess 加名词后缀 -ment。assess 来自拉丁语 assidere「坐在旁边」，由 ad-「向」与 sedere「坐」构成；assessor 原是坐在长官旁边核定税额的官员。因此 assessment 先指「核定应缴数额」这一官方行为，后泛指判断价值、质量、风险的行为，再指教育中的测评制度，最后由行为转指得出的评价与结论。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses grow from one weighing: the act of judging, a course-wide test of learning, an official tax sum, and the verdict reached.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项从同一次称量长出来：判断的行为、贯穿课程的测评、官方核定的税额，以及最终得出的结论。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a stack of marked essays beside a red pen and a column of scores.
core.cn: 核心意象：一叠批改过的作文，旁边是一支红笔与一列分数。

branches.en: THE WEIGHING LINE: judging value or quality is the core act.
branches.cn: 称量线：判断价值或质量是核心动作。

branches.en: THE SCHOOL LINE: the weighing becomes a course-long system.
branches.cn: 学校线：称量变成贯穿课程的制度。

branches.en: THE TAX LINE: an official fixes what a property owes.
branches.cn: 税务线：官员定下产业该缴多少。

branches.en: THE VERDICT LINE: the act turns into the opinion reached.
branches.cn: 结论线：动作转成得出的意见。

branches.en: THE REPORT LINE: a written assessment records both the act and the verdict.
branches.cn: 报告线：书面评估同时记录动作与结论。

intro.en: Assessment is assess plus -ment; its family adds -or, -able and the prefix re-.
intro.cn: assessment 是 assess 加 -ment，词族再加 -or、-able 与前缀 re-。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root sedere 'to sit' also gave assessor and sedentary, keeping the image of sitting beside.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根 sedere「坐」还生出 assessor 与 sedentary，保留着「坐在旁边」的形象。

items.meaning: the act or result of judging
items.example: The assessment was fair to both sides.
items.exampleCN: 这项评估对双方都算公道。

items.example: The school holds two assessments each term.
items.exampleCN: 学校每学期进行两次测评。

items.meaning: to judge or fix a value
items.example: We assess the risk before every flight.
items.exampleCN: 每次飞行前我们都会评估风险。

items.example: The assessor checked the roof.
items.exampleCN: 评估员检查了屋顶。

items.meaning: able to be assessed or taxed
items.example: The gift is not assessable income.
items.exampleCN: 这笔赠与不属于应税收入。

items.example: The city reassessed the flood risk.
items.exampleCN: 城市重新评估了洪水风险。

items.example: The reassessment lowered the tax.
items.exampleCN: 重新核定降低了税额。

items.meaning: judging one's own work or tax
items.meaningCN: 自我评估；自行申报纳税
items.example: Self-assessment saves the office a visit.
items.exampleCN: 自行申报省得跑一趟税务局。

latinEntries.meaning: one who sits beside to judge
latinEntries.meaningCN: 坐在旁边协助判断的人
latinEntries.example: The assessor set the fine at ten pounds.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 估税员把罚金定为十英镑。

latinEntries.example: A sedentary life weakens the legs.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 久坐的生活会让腿变弱。

definition_zh: 作业；任务；分配；指派；派驻；权利转让
definition_en: a piece of work given to someone, the act of giving it, a posting to a job or place, or the transfer of a right
core_image: 黑板上写着本周任务，每行后面跟着一个名字
scene: 教室黑板右角写着本周的阅读任务，几个名字被分到不同的小组。The teacher gave us a writing assignment over the weekend.
sceneCN: 这里 assignment 是「作业、任务」（第 1 个义项：布置给学生的学习任务）；句意为「老师周末给我们布置了一篇写作作业」。画面中有黑板、任务清单与被分到各组的名字。

pos.zh: 名词：作业；任务；分配；指派；派驻；权利转让

derivatives.zh: assignment 的动词形式，义为「分配；指派；确定（时间、地点）」
由 assign 加 -ee 构成，义为「受让人；受托者」
由前缀 re- 加 assign 构成，义为「重新分配；改派」

senses.title: A piece of work given to someone
senses.definition: a piece of work, especially school work, given to a particular person to do
senses.definitionCN: 交给某个人去完成的一项工作，尤指学校作业
senses.example: The teacher gave us a writing assignment over the weekend.
senses.exampleCN: 老师周末给我们布置了一篇写作作业。
senses.why: The verb assign marked something out and handed it to a name; the noun is the thing so handed over.
senses.whyCN: 动词 assign 把某样东西划出来、交到一个名字名下；名词就是被交出去的那件事。

senses.title: The act of giving out work
senses.definition: the act of allocating a task, duty, or resource to a person or group
senses.definitionCN: 把任务、职责或资源分给某人或某组的行为
senses.example: The assignment of desks took longer than expected.
senses.exampleCN: 分配课桌花的时间比预想的长。
senses.why: This is the action side of the same word: the marking out and handing over itself.
senses.whyCN: 这是同一个词的动作面：划出与交出去这件事本身。

senses.title: A posting to a job or place
senses.definition: a job or period of work in a particular place, especially abroad or away from home
senses.definitionCN: 在某一地点、尤指海外或离家之外的工作或任职期
senses.example: She met her husband during an assignment in Kenya.
senses.exampleCN: 她在肯尼亚外派期间遇见了丈夫。
senses.why: A person is assigned to a place, so the posting itself takes the name of the assignment.
senses.whyCN: 人被分配到某个地方，于是这段派驻本身也承袭了 assignment 之名。

senses.title: The transfer of a right
senses.definition: in law, the transfer of a right or property from one person to another
senses.definitionCN: 法律上把某项权利或财产从一人转让给另一人
senses.example: The assignment of the lease required a signature.
senses.exampleCN: 租约的转让需要签字。
senses.why: Legally, a right is marked out from one owner and handed to another, just as a task is.
senses.whyCN: 在法律上，一项权利被从一个所有人名下划出、交到另一人名下，正如任务被交出去一样。

intro.en: Assignment is built on assign, which comes from a Latin phrase meaning to mark something out to someone.
intro.cn: assignment 建立在 assign 上，而 assign 来自一个拉丁短语，意为「把某物标记出来归于某人」。

items.en: Signum meant 'mark, sign', the word behind sign, signal and design.
items.cn: signum 意为「记号、标志」，是 sign、signal 与 design 背后的词。

items.en: Assignare, from ad- 'to' plus signare 'to mark', meant 'to mark out, allot, assign'.
items.cn: assignare 由 ad-「向」加 signare「标记」构成，意为「划出、分配、指派」。

items.en: In law the verb named the transferring of a right, a use that English kept.
items.cn: 在法律上这个动词指权利转让，这一用法被英语保留下来。

items.en: Old French assigner carried the task and property senses into English.
items.cn: 古法语 assigner 把任务义与财产义一并带入英语。

items.en: The noun assignment appears soon after the verb, first for a legal transfer and later for school work.
items.cn: 名词 assignment 紧随动词出现，先指法律转让，后指学校作业。

items.en: Modern use covers homework, shared duties, overseas postings and transferred rights.
items.cn: 现代用法涵盖家庭作业、分担的职责、海外派驻与转让的权利。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers nouns close to assignment in form; the near-meaning group gathers tasks, homework, missions and postings.
note.cn: 形近组收形式上与 assignment 接近的名词；近义组收任务、作业、使命与派驻。

entries.definition: The act of judging value or quality.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「评估、评定」，注意它与 assignment 词源不同。

entries.definition: A batch of goods sent for sale or delivery.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「寄售的一批货物」。

entries.definition: The state of being in line or in agreement.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「对齐、一致」。

entries.definition: A piece of work that must be done.
entries.definitionCN: 必须完成的一项工作。

entries.definition: School work given to be done at home.
entries.definitionCN: 带回家完成的学校作业。

entries.definition: An important job given to a person or group, often abroad.
entries.definitionCN: 交给个人或团体的一项重要任务，常指海外任务。

entries.definition: A job in a particular place, especially abroad.
entries.definitionCN: 在某一地点、尤指海外的工作岗位。

normalIntro.en: These hooks follow assignment from a name on a blackboard to school work, shared desks, an overseas post and a signed transfer.
normalIntro.cn: 下面的钩子让 assignment 从黑板上的名字，走到学校作业、分课桌、海外派驻与签字的转让。

normal.en: Assignment: a task is marked out and a name is put beside it.
normal.cn: assignment：划出一项任务，在旁边写上一个名字。

normal.en: A writing assignment is the thing handed over.
normal.cn: 写作作业就是被交到手里的那件事。

normal.en: The assignment of desks is the handing over itself.
normal.cn: 分配课桌就是「交出去」这个动作本身。

normal.en: An overseas assignment is a posting to a place.
normal.cn: 海外派驻就是被分配到某个地方。

normal.en: A lease assignment hands a right to another name.
normal.cn: 租约转让把一项权利交到另一个名字名下。

abstract.en: One word names the task, the act, the post and the transfer.
abstract.cn: 一个词同时命名了任务、动作、职位与转让。

abstract.en: Everything assigned has been marked out for someone.
abstract.cn: 凡被 assign 的东西，都是为某个人划出来的。

abstract.en: School and law use the same handing-over gesture.
abstract.cn: 学校与法律用的是同一个「交出去」的动作。

examples.en: The teacher gave us a writing assignment over the weekend.
examples.cn: 老师周末给我们布置了一篇写作作业。

examples.en: The assignment of desks took longer than expected.
examples.cn: 分配课桌花的时间比预想的长。

examples.en: She met her husband during an assignment in Kenya.
examples.cn: 她在肯尼亚外派期间遇见了丈夫。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿赛门特」——阿赛门特在黑板上写下一行任务，再把名字填在后面：作业、指派

root: assignment 是 assign 加 -ment。assign 来自拉丁语 assignare「划出、分配」，由 ad-「向」加 signare「标记」构成，而 signare 又出自 signum「记号」。所以这个词的核心动作是「划出来、记到某个名字名下」：被划出来的那件事是作业或任务，划的动作本身是分配与指派，被划到某个地点是派驻，被划到另一个人名下则是法律上的权利转让。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses share one gesture of marking out and handing over: a task, the act of allocation, a posting, and a transferred right.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项共享同一个「划出来交出去」的动作：一项任务、分配的行为、一段派驻，以及转让的权利。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a blackboard listing this week's tasks, a name written beside each line.
core.cn: 核心意象：写着本周任务的黑板，每行后面都写着一个名字。

branches.en: THE TASK LINE: the thing handed to a person is the assignment.
branches.cn: 任务线：交到某人手里的那件事就是 assignment。

branches.en: THE ALLOTMENT LINE: the handing-over itself takes the same name.
branches.cn: 分配线：交出去这个动作本身也取同一个名字。

branches.en: THE POST LINE: a person assigned to a place serves there.
branches.cn: 派驻线：被分配到某地的人就在那里任职。

branches.en: THE LAW LINE: a right is marked out and given to another owner.
branches.cn: 法律线：权利被划出并交给另一个所有者。

branches.en: THE SCHOOL LINE: homework is both the thing given and the giving.
branches.cn: 学校线：作业既是被给出的东西，也是给出这件事。

intro.en: Assignment is assign plus -ment; its family adds -ee, the prefix re-, and the base sign words.
intro.cn: assignment 是 assign 加 -ment，词族再加 -ee、前缀 re- 以及 sign 一族词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin mark word signum also produced signal and design, both built on marking something out.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语中表示记号的 signum 还生出 signal 与 design，两者都建立在「标出」这一动作上。

items.meaningCN: 分配的行为或被分配的事物
items.example: The assignment is due on Monday.
items.exampleCN: 这项作业周一交。

items.example: He finished all three assignments.
items.exampleCN: 他完成了全部三项作业。

items.example: They assign each newcomer a mentor.
items.exampleCN: 他们给每位新人分配一位导师。

items.meaning: a person to whom something is transferred
items.example: The assignee signed the contract.
items.exampleCN: 受让人签了合同。

items.example: The editor reassigned the story.
items.exampleCN: 编辑把这则报道改派给别人了。

items.example: A red sign marked the exit.
items.exampleCN: 一个红色标志标出了出口。

items.meaning: a sign that carries a message
items.example: The lamp gave a warning signal.
items.exampleCN: 那盏灯发出了警告信号。

items.meaning: to plan and mark out a form
items.example: They design each page by hand.
items.exampleCN: 他们手工设计每一页。

latinEntries.example: The ship sent a signal for help.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 那艘船发出了求救信号。

latinEntries.example: The garden was designed for shade.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 这座花园是按遮阴来设计的。

definition_zh: 帮助；协助；援助；（体育）助攻；有助于
definition_en: to help someone do something, to give a sports assist, or to help a process happen more easily
core_image: 一双手从旁边扶住摇摇欲倒的车轮
scene: 修车铺里，学徒扶住倾斜的车轮，师傅腾出手来拧紧螺栓。Two neighbours assisted the old man with his shopping.
sceneCN: 这里 assist 是「帮助、协助」（第 1 个义项：在具体事务上帮某人一把）；句意为「两位邻居帮老人拎了买的东西」。画面中有修车铺、扶住车轮的学徒与腾出手的师傅。

pos.zh: 动词：帮助；协助；援助；（体育）助攻；有助于
名词（体育）：助攻

derivatives.zh: 由 assist 加名词后缀 -ance 构成，义为「帮助；援助」
由 assist 加 -ant 构成，义为「助手；助理」
由 assist 加 -ive 构成，义为「辅助的；助力的」

senses.title: To help with a task
senses.definition: to help someone do something, especially by taking part in the work
senses.definitionCN: 帮助某人做某事，尤指参与其中分担工作
senses.example: Two neighbours assisted the old man with his shopping.
senses.exampleCN: 两位邻居帮老人拎了买的东西。
senses.why: The Latin verb meant to stand beside, and help begins with standing next to someone who needs it.
senses.whyCN: 那个拉丁动词意为「站在旁边」，而帮助正是从站到需要的人身边开始的。

senses.title: A sports assist
senses.definition: in team sports, a pass or play that directly leads to a goal or score by another player
senses.definitionCN: 在团队运动中，直接促成另一名队员得分的一次传球或配合
senses.example: Her assist set up the winning goal.
senses.exampleCN: 她的助攻促成了制胜的一球。
senses.why: The helper stands beside the scorer and makes the final act possible without performing it.
senses.whyCN: 助攻者站在得分者旁边，让最后一击成为可能，却不亲自完成它。

senses.title: To help a process happen
senses.definition: to make a process work more easily or effectively, as a substance or condition
senses.definitionCN: 使某个过程更顺利或更有效，如某种物质或条件所起的作用
senses.example: A little walking assists digestion after a meal.
senses.exampleCN: 饭后稍走一走有助于消化。
senses.why: Here the helper is not a person but a condition that stands beside the process and supports it.
senses.whyCN: 这里的帮手不是人，而是一个站在过程旁边、给它支撑的条件。

intro.en: Assist comes from a Latin verb meaning to stand beside, and its family includes assist, assistance and assistant.
intro.cn: assist 来自一个意为「站在旁边」的拉丁动词，词族包括 assist、assistance 与 assistant。

items.en: The root 「*sta-」 meant 'to stand', and it lies behind Latin sistere and many standing words.
items.cn: 词根「*sta-」意为「站立」，拉丁语 sistere 以及许多表示站立的词都由它而来。

items.en: Sistere meant 'to cause to stand, take one's stand', and assistere added ad- 'to': to stand beside.
items.cn: sistere 意为「使站立、站定」，assistere 又加上 ad-「向」，即「站在旁边」。

items.en: Assistere was used for a person standing by to help, and for soldiers posted nearby.
items.cn: assistere 既用于站在一旁帮忙的人，也用于就近驻扎的士兵。

items.en: Old French assister kept the sense of standing by to give help.
items.cn: 古法语 assister 保留了「站在旁边给予帮助」的意思。

items.en: English assist first meant to be present with and support someone, then to take a share of the work.
items.cn: 英语里的 assist 最初指在场支持某人，后来指分担一部分工作。

items.en: Sports added the assist as a counted act, and medicine speaks of a drug assisting digestion.
items.cn: 体育把助攻变成可计数的行为，医学则说某种药有助于消化。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers verbs close to assist in spelling but with other roots; the near-meaning group gathers verbs of helping and supporting.
note.cn: 形近组收拼写与 assist 接近但词根不同的动词；近义组收表示帮助与支持的动词。

entries.definition: To judge the value or quality of something.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「评估、评定」，注意它与 assist 词源不同。

entries.definition: To be made up of particular parts.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「由……组成」。

entries.definition: To state something firmly and refuse to change.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「坚持、坚决主张」。

entries.definition: To make it easier for someone to do something.
entries.definitionCN: 使某人做某事变得更容易。

entries.definition: To give support or relief, especially in need.
entries.definitionCN: 尤指在需要时给予支持或救济。

entries.definition: To hold something up or give it strength.
entries.definitionCN: 支撑某物或给它力量。

entries.definition: To give help or support to a person or plan.
entries.definitionCN: 给某人或某个计划以帮助或支持。

normalIntro.en: These hooks follow assist from a hand under a wheel to a counted pass, a helping drug and everyday aid.
normalIntro.cn: 下面的钩子让 assist 从扶住车轮的手，走到一次记数的传球、帮上忙的药与日常的援手。

normal.en: Assist means to stand beside.
normal.cn: assist 的意思就是「站在旁边」。

normal.en: One hand under the wheel lets the other hand work.
normal.cn: 一只手扶住车轮，另一只手才能干活。

normal.en: A sports assist is a pass counted as help.
normal.cn: 体育助攻是一次被记成帮助的传球。

normal.en: A drug assists digestion by standing beside the process.
normal.cn: 药物站在消化的过程旁边，推一把。

normal.en: Assistant and assistance are the same stand-beside.
normal.cn: assistant 与 assistance 都是同一个「站旁边」。

abstract.en: Help begins with presence, not with doing the whole job.
abstract.cn: 帮助始于在场，而不是把整件事都做掉。

abstract.en: People, passes and medicines can all assist.
abstract.cn: 人、传球与药物都能 assist。

abstract.en: The helper makes the final act possible without taking it.
abstract.cn: 帮手让最后一击成为可能，却不把它拿走。

examples.en: Two neighbours assisted the old man with his shopping.
examples.cn: 两位邻居帮老人拎了买的东西。

examples.en: Her assist set up the winning goal.
examples.cn: 她的助攻促成了制胜的一球。

examples.en: A little walking assists digestion after a meal.
examples.cn: 饭后稍走一走有助于消化。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿西斯」——阿西斯从旁边扶住倾斜的车轮，让师傅腾出手来：协助

root: assist 来自拉丁语 assistere「站在旁边」，由 ad-「向」加 sistere「站立」构成，词根可追到意为「站」的「*sta-」。它最初指站在某人身边给予支持，后来指分担一部分工作；体育把这种支持变成可计数的助攻；用在药物或条件上，则指「站在某个过程旁边，使它更顺利」。注意它与 assess（坐在旁边称量）词根不同：assist 是站，assess 是坐。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses all mean standing beside: helping with work, supplying the pass before a score, and supporting a bodily process.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项都是「站在旁边」：帮着一块干活、在得分前送出传球，以及给身体过程以支撑。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand holding a tilting wheel steady so another pair of hands can work.
core.cn: 核心意象：一双手扶稳倾斜的车轮，让另一双手腾出来干活。

branches.en: THE PRESENCE LINE: help starts by standing next to someone.
branches.cn: 在场线：帮助从站到某人身边开始。

branches.en: THE PASS LINE: the helper makes the score possible.
branches.cn: 传球线：帮手让得分成为可能。

branches.en: THE PROCESS LINE: a condition stands beside a bodily process and eases it.
branches.cn: 过程线：某个条件站在身体过程旁边，让它顺利些。

branches.en: THE TEAM LINE: a helper and a scorer share one move.
branches.cn: 团队线：帮手与得分者共享同一个动作。

branches.en: THE RELIEF LINE: people and medicines both lighten a load.
branches.cn: 缓解线：人与药物都在减轻负担。

intro.en: Assist is a Latin verb; its family adds -ance, -ant and -ive, with the same standing-beside core.
intro.cn: assist 是拉丁动词，词族加 -ance、-ant 与 -ive，共享同一个「站在旁边」的核心。

latinIntro.en: The Latin standing verb sistere also gave resist and insist, which keep the idea of taking a stand.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语中表示站立的 sistere 还生出 resist 与 insist，它们都保留「站定立场」的意思。

items.example: A nurse assisted the doctor.
items.exampleCN: 一位护士协助医生。

items.meaning: the third person singular or plural noun
items.example: He assists at every home game.
items.exampleCN: 每场主场比赛他都在旁协助。

items.example: She is assisting with the survey.
items.exampleCN: 她正在协助做这项调查。

items.meaning: the past tense and past participle
items.example: Volunteers assisted the flood victims.
items.exampleCN: 志愿者帮助了洪灾灾民。

items.example: He offered assistance at once.
items.exampleCN: 他立刻提出帮忙。

items.example: The assistant answered the phone.
items.exampleCN: 助理接了电话。

items.example: The app has assistive reading tools.
items.exampleCN: 这款应用有辅助阅读的工具。

items.meaningCN: 在没有帮助的情况下完成的
items.example: He climbed the wall unassisted.
items.exampleCN: 他独自爬上了那面墙。

latinEntries.example: They resisted the change for years.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 他们多年抵制这一变化。

latinEntries.meaning: to stand firmly on a point
latinEntries.example: She insisted on paying.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 她坚持要付钱。

definition_zh: 帮助；援助；协助；资助
definition_en: help given to someone, especially practical or financial support, or the act of helping
core_image: 一只递过来的手，旁边是一份写着补助金额的表格
scene: 社区中心的桌上摆着一叠申请表，志愿者在旁边教老人逐栏填写。She applied for financial assistance after the storm.
sceneCN: 这里 assistance 是「帮助、援助」（第 1 个义项：给予他人的实际帮助）；句意为「风暴过后她申请了经济援助」。画面中有申请表、志愿者与逐栏填写的老人。

pos.zh: 名词：帮助；援助；协助；资助

derivatives.zh: assistance 的动词形式，义为「帮助；协助」
由 assist 加 -ant 构成，义为「助手；助理」
由 assist 加 -ive 构成，义为「辅助的」

senses.title: Help given to someone
senses.definition: help or support given to someone who needs it, especially in doing a task
senses.definitionCN: 给予需要之人的帮助或支持，尤指在做事时
senses.example: She applied for financial assistance after the storm.
senses.exampleCN: 风暴过后她申请了经济援助。
senses.why: The suffix -ance names the state or act of standing beside, so assistance is help seen as a thing given.
senses.whyCN: 后缀 -ance 命名「站在旁边」的状态或行为，所以 assistance 是被当作一件东西给出去的帮助。

senses.title: Financial or official aid
senses.definition: money or practical support provided by a government, charity, or organization
senses.definitionCN: 由政府、慈善机构或组织提供的钱款或实际支持
senses.example: The family received assistance with rent and heating.
senses.exampleCN: 这家人得到了房租与取暖方面的补助。
senses.why: Money is one form of standing beside someone, so the word widens from hands to funds.
senses.whyCN: 金钱是「站到某人身边」的一种形式，于是这个词从双手扩展到资金。

senses.title: The act of helping
senses.definition: the act of helping, often named in the phrase with the assistance of
senses.definitionCN: 帮助的行为，常用于短语 with the assistance of
senses.example: With the assistance of two passers-by, the driver escaped.
senses.exampleCN: 在两名路人的帮助下，司机脱了身。
senses.why: Here the noun names the act rather than the thing, the standing-beside itself.
senses.whyCN: 这里的名词指动作而非物品，即「站在旁边」这件事本身。

intro.en: Assistance is the noun of assist, built with the French suffix -ance on the Latin verb for standing beside.
intro.cn: assistance 是 assist 的名词，用法语后缀 -ance 加在那个意为「站在旁边」的拉丁动词上。

items.en: The root 「*sta-」 meant 'to stand', the source of Latin sistere and of many standing words.
items.cn: 词根「*sta-」意为「站立」，是拉丁语 sistere 及许多表示站立的词的来源。

items.en: Assistere meant 'to stand beside', from ad- 'to' plus sistere 'to stand'.
items.cn: assistere 意为「站在旁边」，由 ad-「向」加 sistere「站立」构成。

items.en: The noun assistentia named the act of standing by to help.
items.cn: 名词 assistentia 指站在一旁给予帮助的行为。

items.en: French -ance shaped the noun as assistance, and English took it in that form.
items.cn: 法语后缀 -ance 把这个名词塑造成 assistance，英语直接以这一形式借入。

items.en: Assistance first meant the act of helping, then widened to the help itself, including money.
items.cn: assistance 最初指帮助的行为，后来扩展到帮助本身，包括钱款。

items.en: Modern use ranges from a hand at a door to state welfare and technical aid.
items.cn: 现代用法从门口伸出的一只手，一直延伸到国家福利与技术援助。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers nouns close to assistance in form; the near-meaning group gathers help, aid, support and relief.
note.cn: 形近组收形式上与 assistance 接近的名词；近义组收帮助、援助、支持与救济。

entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「一致性、连贯性」。

entries.definition: The act of making life easier for someone.
entries.definitionCN: 使某人的生活或工作变轻松的行为。

entries.definition: Support or relief given to those in need.
entries.definitionCN: 给予需要者的支援或救济。

entries.definition: Practical or emotional backing given to a person.
entries.definitionCN: 给予某人的实际或情感上的支持。

entries.definition: Money or help given to people in difficulty.
entries.definitionCN: 给予困境中的人的钱款或帮助。

normalIntro.en: These hooks move from a hand at a form to rent money, a shouted warning and a state grant.
normalIntro.cn: 下面的钩子从表格旁伸出的一只手，走到房租补助、一声喊出的提醒与国家救济。

normal.en: Assistance is help turned into a thing you can give.
normal.cn: assistance 是被变成可以交出去的帮助。

normal.en: A volunteer at the form: the hand is beside the pen.
normal.cn: 志愿者站在表格旁：手就在笔的旁边。

normal.en: Financial assistance: money stands beside a family.
normal.cn: 经济援助：钱站到了一个家庭旁边。

normal.en: With the assistance of passers-by: the act itself is named.
normal.cn: 在路人帮助下：这里命名的是动作本身。

normal.en: Public assistance: the state offers the hand.
normal.cn: 公共救助：国家伸出了那只手。

abstract.en: The noun can name the help, the money or the act.
abstract.cn: 这个名词可以指帮助、钱款，也可以指行动。

abstract.en: Assistance is help seen from the side of the giver.
abstract.cn: assistance 是从给予者一侧看到的帮助。

abstract.en: Standing beside is the core of all three senses.
abstract.cn: 「站在旁边」是三个义项共同的核心。

examples.en: She applied for financial assistance after the storm.
examples.cn: 风暴过后她申请了经济援助。

examples.en: The family received assistance with rent and heating.
examples.cn: 这家人得到了房租与取暖方面的补助。

examples.en: With the assistance of two passers-by, the driver escaped.
examples.cn: 在两名路人的帮助下，司机脱了身。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿西斯滕斯」——阿西斯滕斯站在表格旁，把手伸向填表的人：帮助

root: assistance 是 assist 的名词，后缀 -ance 来自法语，可追到拉丁语 assistentia。assist 又来自拉丁语 assistere「站在旁边」，由 ad-「向」加 sistere「站立」构成，词根意为「站」。因此 assistance 的核心就是「站在旁边」：既指给予他人的实际帮助，也指政府或组织提供的钱款与援助，还可以指帮助这一行为本身（常见于 with the assistance of）。它与 assess 的「坐在旁边称量」词根不同。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses share one standing-beside: help given in kind, money or official aid, and the act of helping itself.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项共享同一个「站在旁边」：实物与人力上的帮助、金钱或官方援助，以及帮助这一行为本身。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand offered beside an application form with a grant figure.
core.cn: 核心意象：申请表旁伸出的一只手，表上写着补助金额。

branches.en: THE HAND LINE: practical help given to a person in need.
branches.cn: 援手线：给予需要之人的实际帮助。

branches.en: THE FUND LINE: money and official aid are another hand.
branches.cn: 资金线：钱款与官方援助是另一只手。

branches.en: THE ACT LINE: the noun also names helping itself.
branches.cn: 行动线：这个名词也指帮助这件事本身。

branches.en: THE WELFARE LINE: a volunteer's hand and a state grant share one purpose.
branches.cn: 福利线：志愿者的手与国家补助共享同一个目的。

branches.en: THE SERVICE LINE: help given and help performed are one event seen twice.
branches.cn: 服务线：给出的帮助与施予的行动，是同一件事的两种看法。

intro.en: Assistance is assist plus -ance; its family adds -ant and -ive, all built on standing beside.
intro.cn: assistance 是 assist 加 -ance，词族再加 -ant 与 -ive，全部建立在「站在旁边」上。

latinIntro.en: The Latin standing root sistere also produced resistance and insist, both keeping a firm stance.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语中表示站立的词根 sistere 还生出 resistance 与 insist，两者都保留「站稳立场」的意思。

items.meaning: the act or thing of helping
items.meaningCN: 帮助的行为或被给予的帮助
items.example: She needed assistance with the form.
items.exampleCN: 她填表时需要帮助。

items.example: Staff assist visitors at the gate.
items.exampleCN: 工作人员在门口帮助来访者。

items.example: He assists in the workshop.
items.exampleCN: 他在车间里帮忙。

items.meaning: the past tense and past participle
items.example: The crew assisted the passengers.
items.exampleCN: 机组人员帮助了乘客。

items.example: She was assisting the nurse.
items.exampleCN: 她当时在协助护士。

items.example: The assistant carried the files.
items.exampleCN: 助理抱着文件。

items.example: Assistive technology opens doors.
items.exampleCN: 辅助技术为人们打开大门。

items.example: She walked unassisted after a month.
items.exampleCN: 一个月后她能不靠人扶走路了。

latinEntries.exampleCN: 这个计划遭到强烈抵制。

latinEntries.example: They insist on a written answer.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 他们坚持要一个书面答复。
